scope: Admit direct structured AI evaluation requests under the configured database-backed MJOBS_AI_CONCURRENCY ceiling across API instances. Persist terminal operation outcomes and recover expired inline leases without queueing a retry.
tdd_red: Before implementation, the shared-database/two-API-instance acceptance test returned HTTP 200 to the second profile while the first provider call was blocked, and its synthetic router was entered. After adding durable generic-operation cancellation coverage, the test also showed that a cancel request from the second API instance did not reach the first provider call. The final implementation rejects the second request with 429 / AI_CONCURRENCY_LIMIT, propagates durable cancellation to the provider event, and records cancellation/completion/expired-lease states.

acceptance.cross_instance_limit: PASS - with MJOBS_AI_CONCURRENCY=1, two API app instances using separate Store objects against one SQLite file cannot start overlapping structured evaluations across different profiles; the second receives 429 / AI_CONCURRENCY_LIMIT before its provider is called.
acceptance.capacity_recovery: PASS - after the active evaluation is cancelled and its terminal state is persisted, a new profile evaluation is admitted.
acceptance.operation_lifecycle: PASS - successful structured evaluation records COMPLETED; generic operation cancellation from a separate API instance reaches the in-flight provider cancellation event and records CANCELLED.
acceptance.expired_inline_lease: PASS - an expired AI_EVALUATE lease is marked FAILED / LEASE_EXPIRED and is never requeued for dispatch.
acceptance.profile_history: PASS - evaluation histories remain scoped to the requesting profile; rejected/cancelled work adds no partial run.
acceptance.complete_MJ_REQ_005: PARTIAL - direct structured AI evaluation now shares durable category admission; real ATS automation and live PostgreSQL advisory-lock execution remain unavailable/not verified.

validation.summary: 32 API, operation-concurrency and worker-lifecycle tests passed after the final source changes.
849 tests ran in 476.247 seconds; all passed; 1 optional PostgreSQL concurrency test skipped because MJOBS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL was unset. Browser assets were built in this worktree before the run.
13 frontend test files and 62 tests passed.
TypeScript check and Vite production build passed. npm ci and build emitted an engine warning because Node v25.9.0 is outside Vitest's declared Node 22.12/24/26+ ranges.
All listed local validators, Python bytecode compilation, lane validation and whitespace checks passed.

environment.database: Synthetic API acceptance used two independent Store instances sharing a temporary SQLite database; no schema migration was required.
environment.postgresql: NOT_RUN - MJOBS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL was unset; one optional concurrency test skipped.
environment.docker_runtime: NOT_RUN - the change does not require container runtime validation.
environment.provider_inference: NOT_RUN - provider behavior used a synthetic in-process router; no Ollama or paid/cloud inference was invoked.

limitations: Issue #6 / MJ-REQ-005 remains OPEN/PARTIAL; this slice implements shared durable admission for the direct structured AI evaluation operation, but does not provide real ATS automation or live PostgreSQL concurrency evidence.
The shared-database concurrency oracle used SQLite and separate app/store instances; PostgreSQL advisory-lock behavior remains covered only by existing code and the skipped optional PostgreSQL test.
Hosted checks and independent review remain NOT_RUN_BY_USER_POLICY.
